en-US.author: Yusuke Abe
en-US.description: A developer-friendly CLI wrapper for Microsoft WSLC.
en-US.installationNotes: From PowerShell or cmd, run wip. From a WSL2 shell the extension is required - run wip.exe - because bash does not consult PATHEXT. See https://github.com/slidict/wip#running-it-from-a-wsl2-shell for a shim that lets you type wip there too.
en-US.longDescription: wip is an open-source CLI wrapper that brings a dip-like workflow to Microsoft WSLC. It collects a project's container, image, environment variables, and commands into a single wip.yml file, then forwards them to wslc as safe argument arrays with no shell interpolation. It ships as a single self-contained Native AOT executable, so there is no runtime to install.
en-US.name: wip
